newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian train derailed by wind.
newsitem.headline: Belgian train derailed by wind.

text.p: Wind alone cannot derail a train -- although it might give a helping hand, Belgian railways said on Tuesday after one of its trains came off the rails in high winds.
The a 150-tonne train was derailed close to Veurne, western Belgium on Monday but none of the five people aboard was seriously hurt.
The train driver told Belgian television that a heavy gust of wind had pushed his train off the track.
"That is indeed his impression. But we cannot believe that the wind could be the only factor that caused the accident," a railways spokewoman told Reuters.
One of the passengers was quoted in a newspaper as saying that he had felt a strong gust of wind, after which the train tilted and rode on its right wheels before derailing.
